description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeEmployeeController class within the OrangeHRM project. It is a controller responsible for handling the purge employee functionality in the Maintenance module. The class extends AbstractVueController and implements AdminPrivilegeController, utilizing traits for authentication, administrator access, and configuration services. It contains methods for pre-render setup and request handling, including access control and component setup.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the purge employee feature, ensuring admin privileges, and setting up Vue components for the frontend interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting up the 'purge-employee' component and passing configuration data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, checks for admin access, and forwards unauthorized users accordingly. Otherwise, proceeds with default handling.
